module_metadata.purpose: Godot 4.7 Control.offset_transform_*, VirtualJoystick, searchable PopupMenu, RichTextLabel em images, recursive mouse/focus modes, and interruptible Tween chains.

properties.offset_transform_enabled: bool (default: false) — Must be set to `true` to activate visual offset transforms.
properties.offset_transform_position: Vector2 — Visual pixel translation applied after Container layout.
properties.offset_transform_scale: Vector2 (default: Vector2.ONE) — Visual scale multiplier around `offset_transform_pivot`.
properties.offset_transform_pivot: Vector2 — Pivot offset for visual rotation and scaling.
properties.offset_transform_affects_input: bool (default: false) — When false, hover/click hitboxes stay locked to the layout rect so hover animations never flicker!

control_offset_transforms_4_7_new.example:
card.offset_transform_enabled = true
card.offset_transform_pivot = card.size * 0.5
var t: Tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
t.tween_property(card, ^"offset_transform_position", Vector2(0.0, -12.0), 0.18)
t.tween_property(card, ^"offset_transform_scale", Vector2(1.06, 1.06), 0.18)

virtual_joystick_4_7_new.description: NEW in Godot 4.7: Built-in touchscreen virtual joystick supporting Fixed, Dynamic, and Following modes that feeds directly into InputMap actions.
virtual_joystick_4_7_new.note: Do NOT declare `class_name VirtualJoystick` in user scripts in Godot 4.7, as it collides with the native engine class.

properties: control.mouse_behavior_recursive = Control.MOUSE_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED  # Disables mouse input on control and all descendants
control.focus_behavior_recursive = Control.FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED  # Disables focus on control and all descendants

interruptible_banner_tween_pattern.rule: Never mix `_active_tween.kill()` with `await _active_tween.finished` + `await get_tree().create_timer()`. Build a single self-contained `Tween` using `.chain()` and `.tween_interval()`:

audio_4_7_patterns.interactive_streams: Use `AudioStreamRandomizer` for pitch/sample variation on gunshots/footsteps, and `AudioStreamInteractive` / `AudioStreamSynchronized` for dynamic combat music transitions.
